description: This file contains simplified Pydantic schema definitions for a Documentation Chatbot, including data models for ingestion, query planning, retrieval, citation, and answer schemas.

classes.name: DocumentChunk
classes.description: A single chunk of documentation tied to file + line metadata.

classes.name: IngestReport
classes.description: Summary returned after ingesting a folder of docs.

classes.name: QueryPlan
classes.description: Diverse search queries generated from user question.

classes.name: RetrievalResult
classes.description: Single retrieved chunk with minimal metadata.

classes.name: DocumentContext
classes.description: Full document context aggregated from matching chunks.

classes.name: Citation
classes.description: Citation metadata for rendering inline references.

classes.name: DocAnswer
classes.description: Final response from the QA system - maintains frontend contract.
